content:
I’m pleased to announce the next major release of Radiance. The two main themes of this release are:

  • Expanding on the foundational work of the previous releases around color tokens, painters and shapers
  • The introduction of a brand new skin, Blueprint (image above)

Let’s get to what’s been fixed, and what’s been added. First, I’m going to use emojis to mark different parts of it like this:

 marks an incompatible API / binary change
 marks new features
 marks bug fixes and general improvements

Theming

  •  Introduction of component shapers that replace the previously available button shapers and expand the scope to all components
  •  Revisit the API surface of decoration and overlay painters, folding the overlay painters to be managed by decoration painters, and introducing the brand new inlay painters
  •  New marker-on-container color tokens, replacing the SEPARATOR token association kind
  •  Add Blueprint skin
  •  Unified visuals of tabs and newly added tab decorators that allow custom visuals of tabs, migrating the ribbon task toggle buttons to be painted by tab decorators
  •  Skin-level window decorators
  •  Alphas for color tokens under enabled states
  •  New shadow color token, migrating all drop shadows to use it
  •  Additional customization options for title panes for button icons and title texts
  •  Migrate image / icon filtering to be driven by Chroma tonal palettes
  •  Revisit the visuals of slider thumbs
  •  Fix the visuals of highlights to properly account for offsets
  •  Fix the visuals of selected password field dots
  •  Fix the visuals of tree expand / collapse icons
  •  Fix the visuals of indeterminate vertical progress bars
  •  Fix the visuals of the ribbon under skins that use the matte decoration painter
  •  Fix incorrect handling of icon alpha channels
  •  Consistent width handling for tree cell renderers
  •  Tweak the default insets of toolbars
  •  Fix enabled state of window menu bar items

Component

  •  Fix the display of the popup action icon of ribbon anchored commands with no icons
  •  Use the HCT color space for color derivation in color selector command menus
  •  Fix inconsistent size of ribbon task toggle buttons under skins that use the PillComponentShaper

Radiance focuses on helping you make elegant and high-performing desktop applications in Swing. If you’re in the business of writing just such apps, I’d love for you to take this Radiance release for a spin. Click here to get the instructions on how to add Radiance to your builds.
